shorts_extract.hook: Why falling asleep fast after a 3 PM coffee still leaves your sleeping brain wired like daytime.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Thölke, Carrier & Jerbi (2025, Communications Biology): overnight EEG across 40 adults showed caffeine shifts unconscious NREM sleep into wake-like criticality.
shorts_extract.twist: Gardiner et al. (2023) proved even one regular cup of coffee needs 8.8 hours before bed—and evening doses delay your circadian clock by 40 minutes.
